game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ember hounds.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ember hounds. Each round, a new ash bricks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of ash bricks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 59 seconds.
